spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §4.4 (validation table: Frame without a body set -> 401)
description: An unknown oneof case (unknown message type) at Frame level: the Frame decodes, but the unknown field never sets body, so the Frame is 'without a body set' -> Error(401)+Close(401).
preconditions: Session CONNECTING (any pre-auth state behaves identically; the frame never reaches a message handler).
The oneof case number 80 is inside the reserved 80+ band (spec §4.1); a future revision could assign it.

steps.note: Field 80 is not a known message type in this schema.

assertions: Unknown proto3 fields are ignored (spec §4.4 validation table), but ignoring them leaves the body oneof UNSET — and a Frame with no body set is malformed (401). The evolution rule cannot rescue an unknown message type.
request_id 0 (absent): the offending frame carries no interpretable request.
Fatal Error+Close with the same code, then the transport close carries the code (spec §5.2 fatal-error class).
